name: Pond Button
description: A button whose surface is water: a press sends rings out from the press point and a little way past its edge.

props.name: variant
props.description: The surface: ink, water or a raised card. Each has its own crest and trough shades for the rings, in both themes.

props.name: rings
props.description: Rings sent out per press, from 1 to 5. Each is a thin light crest with a darker trough inside it; they spread past the edge for about 28 pixels and fade. Keyboard presses ripple from the centre.

props.name: iconStart
props.description: Icon before the label. Sized to 16 pixels.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button. Hovering sends a slow sheen across the surface; under reduced motion a press gives a short soft glow instead of rings.
